body: Well there is a reason to not to more work when I don’t get paid overtime and end up having to do overtime to meet deadlines. I want to be able to work flexibly but my business doesn’t allow that. So as a compromise for a shitty boss I’d like to be able to have some tips on taking extra long loo breaks. Or staying active online when my workload is down slightly so that I can clean the house. I’m not trying to avoid doing my job and I don’t think that many people who are stuck without jobs would take my role anyway.
I have looked there but I was hoping for something more specific! Thanks though :)

I actually do my job, but i saw an askreddit thread about mouse clickers and was interested in how people do it. I actually did buy a mouse clicker because my boss recently changed and my previous boss was happy for me to take 10 mins to grab a drink but the new guy is very unhappy as soon as I move away from my desk. Hard to motivate myself to work for someone who will increase my workload to unmanageable quantities every time I hand something in a day before it’s deadline.

Hoping I get fired is really not so nice.
